result:
Compiled successfully on the first attempt.

`tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/TypeUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering every public member of `TypeUtils` documented in `api/`:

- `WILDCARD_ALL`, the deprecated public constructor
- `containsTypeVariables`, `determineTypeArguments`, `equals`
- `genericArrayType`, `getArrayComponentType`
- `getImplicitBounds`, `getImplicitLowerBounds`, `getImplicitUpperBounds` (including the documented "empty → implicit single value" case via `WILDCARD_ALL`)
- `getRawType`, `getTypeArguments` (both overloads, including the javadoc's own `Properties`/`Map` example and the `Outer<K,V>.Inner<T>.DeepInner<E>` owner-hierarchy example)
- `isArrayType`, `isAssignable`, `isInstance`
- `normalizeUpperBounds` (using the javadoc's `Collection`/`List` example)
- `parameterize`/`parameterizeWithOwner` (all four overloads, with `NullPointerException` cases per the docs)
- `toLongString`, `toString`
- `typesSatisfyVariables`, `unrollVariables`
- `wildcardType()`/`WildcardTypeBuilder` (fluent chaining)
- `wrap(Class)`/`wrap(Type)`

Small generic fixture types (`Box`, `Holder`, `A`/`B`/`C`, `Outer`/`Inner`/`DeepInner`, etc.) are nested privately inside the test class to exercise reflection scenarios, keeping the file self-contained. `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
